summary: Apyx Medical Corporation filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, announcing it received expanded FDA 510(k) clearance for its AYON Body Contouring System to include power liposuction. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details this regulatory milestone, which adds a second advanced liposuction modality to the system. No financial terms, shareholder actions, board recommendations, or transaction mechanics are involved. This is a routine product development announcement, not a special situation. There is no deal structure, premium, or risk-arb angle to monitor. The event is purely operational and regulatory in nature.
